description: Bring up a self-implemented inference engine for official Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 on the local Apple M5 Pro (20 GPU cores, 48 GiB unified memory). Planned acceptance targets supplied by the user: prefill >= 500 tokens/s and decode >= 50 tokens/s, in addition to functional and correctness gates. No fixed budget; stop on user request. No candidate measurements have been obtained.
scope: Authorized to complete this new local M5 Pro experiment and submit the reviewed experiment report as a separate results PR. Candidate: independently implemented .NET + Metal, official FP8 checkpoint, FP32 compute/state, 4096-token initial window. Planned prefill >=500 tokens/s and decode >=50 tokens/s. No fixed budget; stop on user request. Baseline is a disclosed affine8/BF16 configuration and is not precision-matched. Keep evaluations unchanged, preserve stage gates, and do not merge PRs or modify OS limits/power. Raw weights, binaries, private prompts/transcripts and machine addresses remain local-only.

hardware.toolchain: .NET SDK 10.0.100 for candidate; Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2); runtime Metal shader compilation verified on Apple M5 Pro; Metal 4; macOS 26.6.2 (25G83). Baseline: Python 3.12.13, MLX 0.32.4, MLX-LM pinned separately. No offline Metal compiler or system changes required.
hardware.power: Observed AC power, battery charged; configured powermode=2 for AC and battery. No power settings modified; re-observe before each run.
hardware.gpu_memory_limit: OS default; observed recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize=44023414784 bytes (41 GiB), maxBufferLength=30150672384 bytes. No global memory-limit override or forced wiring. Re-observe allocation and pressure during actual runs.

target_model.weights: Official FP8 E4M3 checkpoint, 128x128 block scaling, with excluded BF16 tensors. Weight-only FP8 storage with FP32 math; no affine INT8/INT4 substitution. Text inference only, greedy, thinking disabled, no vision/MTP path, 4096-token initial served window. MTP and vision tensors are not executed.
target_model.activation_precision: FP32 activations and accumulation; FP8 E4M3 checkpoint weights remain packed and are decoded in Metal kernels. Excluded BF16 tensors retain their source values and are promoted to FP32 for computation.
target_model.kv_precision: FP32; initial 4096-token served context; unscaled text RoPE; request-isolated KV reset.
target_model.recurrent_state_precision: FP32 recurrent state and depthwise-convolution state, consistent with the official mamba_ssm_dtype=float32 configuration.

baselines.selection_method: Primary-source selection: MLX-LM official repository at 6b572ab1b531dd8fd2d13f6f36a89c2eccda18ea supports Qwen3.5/3.6 MoE on Apple Metal. A source inspection found no Qwen support for this official E4M3 checkpoint layout, so the independently pinned baseline uses existing verified mlx-community/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-8bit revision e06a74e6236a60c8367e1a3214e83d8b61b637b0, affine8/group64, with MLX 0.32.4. Generic protocol adapter 6992293876fe2e666923f7b19d17747611844a34 supplies Responses/Anthropic envelopes and input validation without changing model-generated content. The baseline uses BF16 activation/KV defaults; candidate uses FP32. Differences are disclosed and no matched-precision speedup or SOTA coverage is claimed. Other CUDA-only or conversion-dependent engines were not selected for this local Apple-device preflight.

goal.primary_metric: Use the pinned engine-throughput headline workloads prefill.in2k.out1 and decode.in128.out256. Prefill throughput is processed uncached prompt tokens divided by client dispatch-to-first-output-chunk time, including queueing, transfer, and the first sampled token. Decode is the ratio of summed N-1 output-token intervals to summed first-to-last output-chunk durations, subject to the repository driver chunk-density gate. The 500/50 tokens/s values are planned acceptance targets, not measurements.
goal.quality_gate: Load the selected official FP8 model and generate through the independently implemented .NET + Metal inference path. Pass the pinned engine-api-conformance gate before throughput measurement. Apply the repository-owned workload length, usage, cache, and streaming gates and record every failed pass. Numerical equivalence to a reference implementation is not required by the updated protocol. HumanEval application scoring is a separately available evaluation, not selected in this initial throughput experiment.
